join.title: Join a device
join.body: Enter another device's address and PIN

host.title: Host on this device
host.body: Create a connection for another device

join.addressHint: The IPv4 address and port the other device shows
join.addressInvalid: Enter an IPv4 address and port, such as 192.168.1.100:12345
join.scanDenied: Camera access was denied. Allow the camera in the system settings to scan a code.
join.scanInvalid: That code is not a LettuceAI sync code.
join.scanUnavailable: The camera could not be opened.

host.body1: Make this device available to another device on your network.
host.body2: Once connected, both devices compare and exchange their latest changes.

sharing.qr: QR code with the address, port and PIN of this device
sharing.addressPicker: Address shown in the QR code
sharing.pinBody: Share this PIN with the connecting device
sharing.step1: Open LettuceAI on the other device
sharing.step2: Go to Settings, then Local sync
sharing.step3: Scan the QR code, or enter the address and PIN

request.title: Connection request
request.body: {{name}} wants to sync with this device.

ready.title: Ready to sync
ready.body: {{name}} is connected. Start syncing to begin the transfer.

progress.connectingBody: Waiting for the other device to accept and start syncing.

completed.title: Sync complete
completed.upToDate: Both devices were already up to date.

reason.invalid_state: Sync cannot do that right now. Stop the session and try again.
reason.addresses_unavailable: This device has no network address to share. Connect to a network and try again.
reason.media_unavailable: Some media files could not be read, so the sync stopped.
reason.authentication_failed: The PIN is wrong. Check the PIN on the host device and try again.
reason.pairing_locked: Too many wrong PINs. Stop hosting on the other device and start it again to get a new PIN.
reason.declined: The other device declined the connection.
reason.disconnected: The connection to the other device was lost.
reason.protocol: The other device could not be understood. Both devices must use the same LettuceAI version.
reason.storage: The data on this device could not be read or saved.
reason.pending_batch: An earlier sync left changes that have not been applied yet. Restart the app and try again.
reason.required_reference_unavailable: The other device sent data that refers to something this device does not have.

conflicts.title: Sync conflicts
conflicts.emptyBody: Conflicts appear here when both devices changed the same thing.
conflicts.changedMeanwhile: This item changed in the meantime. The latest versions are shown now.
conflicts.forkBody: Messages from both devices were kept as separate branches.
conflicts.forkLocal: The copied branch holds this device's messages.
conflicts.forkOther: The copied branch holds the other device's messages.

disclaimer: Both devices send and receive changes over your local network. Keep this screen open on both devices until the sync finishes. They must use the same LettuceAI version.
